problem_text:
A logistics company needs to coordinate 9 delivery routes through 9 distribution centers.

Each route consists of a sequence of handling steps represented as (Center, Duration) pairs, where each pair specifies the distribution center where the step must occur and the time required to complete it. The order of pairs indicates the mandatory sequence in which these handling steps must be performed.

Route details:
* R1 requires the sequence: (C6, 10) → (C3, 4) → (C1, 7) → (C4, 1) → (C9, 10) → (C7, 4) → (C5, 7) → (C2, 10) → (C8, 8)
* R2 requires the sequence: (C8, 2) → (C7, 9) → (C4, 10) → (C9, 8) → (C1, 3) → (C3, 10) → (C5, 7) → (C6, 4) → (C2, 3)
* R3 requires the sequence: (C5, 10) → (C1, 1) → (C4, 8) → (C3, 3) → (C7, 5) → (C6, 4) → (C9, 6) → (C8, 1) → (C2, 5)
* R4 requires the sequence: (C7, 3) → (C4, 7) → (C1, 10) → (C2, 8) → (C5, 6) → (C8, 8) → (C9, 10) → (C6, 3) → (C3, 1)
* R5 requires the sequence: (C7, 10) → (C9, 4) → (C3, 8) → (C8, 4) → (C2, 3) → (C6, 8) → (C5, 8) → (C4, 1) → (C1, 7)
* R6 requires the sequence: (C4, 4) → (C5, 5) → (C6, 3) → (C9, 3) → (C1, 6) → (C3, 4) → (C2, 10) → (C8, 10) → (C7, 3)
* R7 requires the sequence: (C1, 5) → (C2, 10) → (C8, 6) → (C3, 2) → (C5, 7) → (C6, 5) → (C7, 6) → (C9, 10) → (C4, 9)
* R8 requires the sequence: (C9, 10) → (C5, 8) → (C7, 6) → (C1, 10) → (C8, 4) → (C6, 2) → (C4, 7) → (C2, 7) → (C3, 2)
* R9 requires the sequence: (C5, 1) → (C6, 6) → (C8, 6) → (C2, 9) → (C1, 10) → (C9, 10) → (C4, 7) → (C7, 9) → (C3, 2)

Each handling step must be completed without interruption once it begins, and each distribution center can only accommodate one handling step at a time. The objective is to determine the processing sequence of all handling steps across the distribution centers so that the total completion time for all delivery routes is minimized.
